info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Adopteds-v3-spec
info.description: The Adopted Pets Listing API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of pets that have been successfully adopted through the pet adoption service. This endpoint provides crucial insights into the adoption trends and helps organizations track the status of pets post-adoption. Typical consumers include animal shelters, adoption agencies, and pet welfare organizations looking to promote their success stories. By using this API, stakeholders can better understand adoption patterns and improve their outreach strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows retrieval of all pets that have been adopted. You can use this information to track adoption statistics and understand the demand for various types of pets.
